---
name: Feature request
about: Propose a capability, tool, widget or integration
title: '[FEATURE] '
labels: enhancement
assignees: ''

---

**The problem**
Who needs this and what is hard or impossible today? Describe the situation, not only the solution.

**Proposed solution**
What should Atena do? Give example sentences ("apri la lavagna…"), screens or API calls where relevant.

**Where it fits**
- [ ] New feature / agent
- [ ] New tool for agents and MCP
- [ ] Display widget
- [ ] Algorithm (skill)
- [ ] Installation step or system service
- [ ] Integration with an external service or device
- [ ] Improvement to an existing feature: <!-- which one -->

**Security and privacy**
- What data does it read, store or send, and where does it go?
- Which actions can it perform on the real world, and which must be confirmed?
- Can it be switched off, and is it optional if it needs an external service?

**Alternatives considered**
Other approaches, including doing it with existing features or MCP.

**Willingness to contribute**
- [ ] I can implement this and open a pull request (see [CONTRIBUTING.md](../../CONTRIBUTING.md))
- [ ] I can test it on real hardware
